evidenceContract.userBehavior: $media-preparation 参考 @source-page.png 中的旅人，只准备一张侧面人物插画的生成输入，用于书签：深灰底、干净黑白墨线、竖幅，保留左侧背包和手灯。这不是动画制作或角色全套设定，不需要其他角度；本轮不生成。 创作语言明确设为英文：请用英文编写最终生成提示词、负面提示词和验收说明，但不要翻译或改变资源标识、人物左右位置、手灯与黑白墨线设计。

observables.description: Exact Skill injection and model identity, creator-facing preparation inputs, no generation calls; semantic design quality is assessed separately.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: Prepare one portrait side-view illustration prompt and acceptance with source-bound pack/lamp identity. Respect black-white ink target and standalone scope; no mandatory turnaround, animation range or video dependency. Honor the explicit English creative-language setting despite the Chinese Skill body; preserve all original visual constraints and native resource identifiers.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Force a multi-view sheet, refuse for missing rear view, expand into an animation asset batch or force color/3D/widescreen.
